platform: Same Apple M1 as the previous secured and old direct125M measurements

measurement.scope: Serial warm-cache fresh-process spawn through observed child exit including secured CLI acquisition/output/report; standard Rust1ms polling. Build, hashing and parent validation excluded; not kernel or cold-cache timing.

comparison.scope: Whole implementation difference, not isolated capability overhead. Old code used packed lowering, compact counters and four partitions. All comparisons here use the same full125M input on this M1.

implementation: A shared generic CRLF predicate first checks whether any carriage return exists; when absent, skip adjacent-pair comparisons. If present, retain the exact existing pair test.
ASCII grapheme count returns byte length when carriage return is absent. CRLF still counts as one grapheme; non-ASCII retains the canonical Unicode segmenter.
Window/query/histogram and borrowed String representation guards use the shared predicate. All owner pins, pre-admission calls/amounts, errors, fallback, atomic publication and one host round remain.
No new dependency, allocation, unsafe code, ABI/control IR/work-policy change or workload/name/hash/alphabet specialization. The aggregate-source workspace correction is included.
